about: Open-Meteo: free, keyless weather APIs. The CLI provides forecasts, historical reanalysis, archived and previous model runs, ensembles, seasonal and climate projections, marine, air quality, satellite radiation, flood, elevation, geocoding and CSV export.

commands.summary: Find places by name or postal code and get their coordinates, timezone, country and population. Use this first to turn a city name into latitude/longitude.

params.name: name
params.description: Location name or postal code. You can narrow it with ', <country or admin1>', e.g. 'Paris, Texas'. Two characters must match exactly; three or more are prefix-matched.

params.name: language
params.description: Language for the returned names, as an ISO 639-1 code (en, fr, de, ...)

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Return only results in this ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country, e.g. US, GB, DE

commands.summary: Weather forecast for one or more coordinates: current conditions plus hourly and daily variables, up to 16 days ahead and 92 past days, with an optional national model (e.g. DWD ICON).

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees. Comma-separate values for several locations, e.g. 52.52,48.85

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. For several locations, comma-separate in the same order as latitude

params.name: daily
params.description: Comma-separated daily variables, e.g. temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,sunrise,sunset,weather_code. Needs timezone.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily aggregation, e.g. Europe/Paris, or 'auto' for the location's timezone. Defaults to GMT.

params.name: forecast_days
params.description: Number of forecast days (0-16). Defaults to 7.

params.name: past_days
params.description: Number of past days to include (0-92)

params.name: start_date
params.description: Explicit start date (yyyy-mm-dd). Use together with end_date instead of forecast_days/past_days.

params.name: models
params.description: Weather model(s), comma-separated, e.g. dwd_icon_seamless, ecmwf_ifs025, gfs_seamless, meteofrance_seamless, ukmo_seamless, jma_seamless. Defaults to best_match.

params.name: timeformat
params.description: Timestamp format: ISO8601 local strings, or unix seconds

commands.summary: Download a weather forecast as CSV text (the docs page's CSV export), for spreadsheets or bulk processing.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees; comma-separate for several locations

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees; comma-separate for several locations

commands.summary: Historical observed-like weather (ERA5 reanalysis, 1940 to a few days ago) for coordinates over a date range, as hourly and/or daily variables.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees; comma-separate for several locations

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees; comma-separate for several locations

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone or 'auto'. Needed for daily values.

params.name: models
params.description: Reanalysis model, e.g. era5, era5_land, era5_seamless, cerra, ecmwf_ifs

commands.summary: Download historical (ERA5) weather for a date range as CSV text.
Archived high-resolution model forecasts (from 2022 onward) for coordinates and a date range, with the same variables and models as the forecast API.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees; comma-separate for several locations

params.name: models
params.description: Weather model(s), e.g. dwd_icon_seamless, ecmwf_ifs025, gfs_seamless

commands.summary: Compare forecasts from earlier model runs at fixed lead times by requesting <variable>_previous_dayN variables alongside the current run.

params.name: hourly
params.description: Comma-separated hourly variables; append _previous_day1 ... _previous_day7 to get the forecast issued N days earlier, e.g. temperature_2m,temperature_2m_previous_day1

params.name: past_days
params.description: Past days to include (0-92). Do not combine with start_date/end_date.

params.name: forecast_days
params.description: Forecast days to include (0-16). Do not combine with start_date/end_date.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Explicit start date yyyy-mm-dd (data from Jan 2024; some models from March 2021). Use with end_date instead of past_days/forecast_days.

params.name: models
params.description: Weather model(s), e.g. ecmwf_ifs025, gfs_seamless, dwd_icon_seamless

commands.summary: Full forecast horizon of one specific model run, identified by its initialisation time.

params.name: run
params.description: Model initialisation time in UTC, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm, e.g. 2026-10-17T00:00

params.name: forecast_days
params.description: Number of days of the run to return. Defaults to 7.

commands.summary: Ensemble forecast with every perturbed member (variable_memberNN), or ensemble mean/spread when you pass a *_ensemble_mean_* model.

params.name: models
params.description: Ensemble model(s), e.g. icon_seamless, icon_global, gfs_seamless, ecmwf_ifs025. For means use dwd_icon_eps_ensemble_mean_seamless or ncep_gefs_ensemble_mean_seamless.

params.name: forecast_days
params.description: Forecast days (default 7, up to 35 depending on model)

commands.summary: Long-range seasonal and sub-seasonal forecast (ECMWF SEAS5 / EC46, about 6-7 months) with ensemble members.
Downscaled daily climate-change projections from CMIP6 models for 1950-2050 at a location.

params.name: models
params.description: Climate model(s), comma-separated: CMCC_CM2_VHR4, FGOALS_f3_H, HiRAM_SIT_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, EC_Earth3P_HR, MPI_ESM1_2_XR, NICAM16_8S

commands.summary: Marine forecast for a sea location: wave height, direction and period, swell, and ocean currents.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (must be over sea)

commands.summary: Air quality forecast: pollutants (PM10, PM2.5, ozone, NO2, ...), pollen, and European/US AQI, both hourly and current.
Satellite-derived solar irradiance (GHI, direct, diffuse, DNI) for a location, near-real-time and archive.

params.name: temporal_resolution
params.description: 'native' returns the satellite's native interval (e.g. 10 min); 'hourly' aggregates to hours

commands.summary: Simulated river discharge (GloFAS) near a location, for flood forecasting: 1984 up to about 7 months ahead.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (snaps to the nearest river)

params.name: daily
params.description: Comma-separated daily variables: river_discharge, river_discharge_mean, river_discharge_median, river_discharge_max, river_discharge_min, river_discharge_p25, river_discharge_p75

commands.summary: Terrain elevation in meters (Copernicus DEM, 90 m) for one or more coordinates.

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude(s), comma-separated in the same order
